tasks.checkbox: get_window_state (tree + screenshot) -> jev-use eligible_controls lookup of 'I agree' -> click(element_token, delivery_mode=background)
tasks.text: the same observation -> lookup of Note and Save note -> set_value(Note, unique token) -> click(Save note, background)

forced_path: AT-SPI DoAction (click, cached-ref route, background delivery, focus guard) and AT-SPI set_value + button; route taken from receipts (route == accessibility) and the full N-01R mark chain on every action
oracle: the fixture's own state file (cua.gtk3_task_state_v1), read by an independent harness thread every 2 ms; T ends at the read-end of the first sample that started at or after the last action's tool return and shows the expected state

arms.HC_method: B-01 H_C method without monkeypatching: a ClientSession subclass overrides _validate_tool_result; every arm calls tools/list once before T; HC arms compile one validator per distinct output schema right after it (validator_for + check_schema + cls(schema, registry=Registry())), outside T, and validate each result with best_match(iter_errors(structuredContent)), the acceptance rule of jsonschema.validate; non-HC arms run the library path unchanged
arms.common: every arm: fresh fixture + fresh Driver per trial, phase trace on, telemetry off (CUA_DRIVER_RS_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=0, DO_NOT_TRACK=1), set_agent_cursor_motion sent before T ({} in non-fast arms), scripted chooser

design.main: 4x4 Williams square, 24 rounds per task, both tasks per round with the first task alternating by round; each task runs its 4 arms in Williams row (round mod 4). n = 24 per arm per task, 192 trials, paired within the round. Two EXCLUSIVE quiet-timed acquisitions of 12 rounds (96 trials, about 5 minutes each)
design.phase1: Phase 1 attribution uses the S0 (checkbox) and X (text) cells of the same 24 rounds (n = 24 per task); the HC/CL arms are decomposed the same way
design.smoke: d01: 4 trials, arm D = every CUA_DRIVER_EXP_* unset, shared lock (default-off check of the N2 binary)
design.controls: c01..c12, shared lock, 20 trials per block: per task, every arm x {decoy 100 ms, edge steal at 205.0-215.0 ms in 10 evenly spaced values, no steal} x 10, arms in Williams order
design.pilot: p01-p03 (shared lock, excluded from every result): 8 main + 4 edge + 2 no-steal trials to validate the harness
design.statistics: medians; nearest-rank p95; paired within-round differences base - arm (positive = arm faster); percentile bootstrap over rounds, 10000 resamples, seed 9101

metrics.T: first get_window_state send -> oracle confirmation (as N-01R)
metrics.decomposition: N-01R components with contiguous boundaries; Driver marks (wall ns) mapped to the caller monotonic clock with the trial's median wall-mono offset

transport_parts.client_send: call start m0 -> Driver request_read; sub-spans client_build (m0 -> hand-off to the stdio writer task) and client_write_pipe (hand-off -> request_read: JSON dump, pipe write, Driver read_line wake)
transport_parts.driver_read_handler: request_read -> registry dispatch_enter; sub-spans drv_parse, drv_admission (parse_done -> handler_start: protocol validate + validate_tool_call(tools_list) + session identity + bookkeeping), drv_inner_pre (handler_start -> dispatch_enter)
transport_parts.driver_serialize_write: registry dispatch_exit -> response_written; sub-spans drv_inner_post (dispatch_exit -> handler_end: SDK return, Driver-side result conformance, finish_response), drv_bookkeep_serialize (handler_end -> serialize_done: post-handler session bookkeeping + serde), drv_write (serialize_done -> response_written: stdout write + flush)
transport_parts.client_read_validate: response_written -> call return m1; sub-spans client_pipe_read_parse (-> arrival of the parsed message on the session read stream), client_result_model (-> validate start), client_validate (ClientSession._validate_tool_result span), client_return (-> m1)
transport_parts.identity: per call, the four parts sum to N-01R's transport: (m0 -> dispatch_enter) + (dispatch_exit -> m1)

verdicts.HC: DELETED (KEEP, caller-side) if the 95% CI of median(T_base - T_HC) excludes 0 on the positive side, every trial of both arms is valid and verified (identical outcomes), and the HC equivalence control agrees on 80/80; otherwise NOT_MATERIAL. Evaluated per task (S0 vs S0+HC; X vs X+HC)
verdicts.transport_parts_not_removed_by_HC: IRREDUCIBLE: drv_bookkeep_serialize and drv_write (Driver-side serialize/write). Kernel pipe time is not isolated from the Python reader/writer, so the spans that contain it (client_write_pipe, client_pipe_read_parse) are named UNTESTED with their ms. Every other sub-span (client_build, drv_parse, drv_admission, drv_inner_pre, drv_inner_post, client_result_model, client_return) is named UNTESTED with its ms; client_validate takes the HC verdict
verdicts.CL: DELETED (product fix candidate; default unchanged until reviewed) if the 95% CI of median(T_base - T_CL) excludes 0 on the positive side, the median saving is at least 10 ms, and both steal controls pass 10/10 in every arm; if the controls pass but the saving is under 10 ms or the CI includes 0: NOT_MATERIAL; any steal miss in any arm: KILL. Evaluated per task (S0 vs S0+CL; X vs X+CL)
verdicts.steal_pass: a steal trial passes when the decoy stole, the independent focus sampler's final (focus, active) equals the pre-trial values, and the click receipt reports focus_outcome=restored (the guard detected and restored). Any other outcome is a miss. Steal timing is reported per trial (after do_action_replied, after the guard start, inside the 220 ms watch or not) but does not exclude a trial
verdicts.nosteal: false restore = the receipt reports focus_outcome=restored or the focus sampler saw any change; reported for every arm (main trials too)
verdicts.load_sensitivity: OLS of observation and action transport on 1-minute loadavg over this run's main trials, reported next to N-01R's S0/X medians at loadavg ~17.1 (from its committed trial metrics). Different binaries and host states: qualitative only, never combined or ratioed
verdicts.untested_share: per trial, median over the cell, for checkbox S0/S0+HC/S0+CL/S0+HC+CL and text X/X+HC/X+CL/X+HC+CL. standard: action-call transport sub-spans named UNTESTED (+ client_validate when HC is NOT_MATERIAL) + resolution + runner + unattributed time, over T; the observation transport is IRREDUCIBLE by invariant as in N-01R. conservative: additionally the observation call's UNTESTED transport sub-spans (+ its client_validate when HC is NOT_MATERIAL) and its T0 -> send residual

controls.HC_equivalence: offline (hostless, no display): 40 real structuredContent results from the first measured block's corpus (per tool, first in corpus order: get_window_state 8, click 12, set_value 6, list_windows 6, set_agent_cursor_motion 4, get_agent_cursor_state 4) + 40 mutants (strategies add_unknown_property, drop_required, wrong_type, root_not_object tried from index mod 4; the first one the library path rejects is kept). Reference = mcp ClientSession._validate_tool_result (jsonschema.validate); candidate = the harness's compiled path. Required: identical accept/reject 80/80
controls.CL_safety: decoy (pre-mapped harness X window, EWMH activate + raise + XSetInputFocus) steals the focus 100 ms after the app's state change (DoAction effect), and an edge steal at 205-215 ms, inside the 220 ms window; n = 10 per arm per task (all 4 arms: the CL arms and the default arms). Required: detect and restore 10/10 in every arm; any miss means CL KILL. No-steal control n = 10 per arm per task
controls.default_off_smoke: arm D, 4 trials: no CUA_DRIVER_EXP_* in the Driver environment, no exp_knob marks, post-action sleep 50-60 ms and settle >= 220 ms
controls.negative_fallback: the library validation path is the fallback of the compiled path (schema not compiled -> library path); CL off is the fallback of CL

gates.validity: at least 95% valid and verified per arm (23/24)
gates.invariants: 0 stale dispatches, 0 duplicate mutations (final seq = before + 1), 0 unverified successes (T always ends on the oracle; click receipts are unverifiable)

locks: measured blocks e01/e02 under bin/quiet-timed (EXCLUSIVE, receipt in the shared ledger), each under 15 minutes; smoke, controls and pilot under flock -s on the quiet-lane lock (<= 20 trials per acquisition); unit tests and builds under the cargo-build lock
isolation: every code-executing command: TMPDIR=<lane tmp> hostless hostless-strict <cmd>; GUI/Driver work inside cua-x11-session.sh with CUA_SESSION_ATSPI=1 and CUA_SESSION_EXTRA_ENV="CUA_SESSION_ATSPI=1 CUA_DRIVER_RS_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=0 DO_NOT_TRACK=1"
pilot_observations: p01-p03 (14 trials, shared lock, excluded): 14/14 valid and verified; full MCP span / client stamp coverage; the clamp ends the last settle poll at ~220 ms (S0+CL 221.7 ms vs S0 242.3 ms); edge steals at ~211-212 ms after the guard start were detected and restored in S0, S0+CL, X and X+CL; client_validate is the largest transport sub-span in non-HC arms. No design change followed from the pilot
diagnostics_not_verdicts: settle_polls and the last settle_poll time after the guard start (the detecting poll in steal trials); steal time relative to do_action_replied and to the guard start; observation payload JSON size
exclusions: pilot blocks only. Every measured trial is kept; a failed block attempt keeps its cells and is re-run under a new label; the latest attempt of each planned cell is used and earlier attempts are reported
claim_boundary: GTK3 canonical fixture, AT-SPI background delivery, X11 Xvfb/openbox/picom, Driver binary N2 (194a6342e), scripted chooser, fresh Driver per trial. A verdict transfers to R2-10's source by mechanism only
